description.value:
You plant a delayed charge at a point within range. The charge detonates when the power ends, whether by your choice or by your concentration breaking, unleashing an explosion that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature there must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to the accumulated total on a failure or half as much on a success.

The charge starts at 12d6 damage, increasing by 1d6 for every full turn it remains undetonated. If someone touches the charge before it goes off, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or the power ends immediately, triggering the explosion. The blast spreads around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects in the area.

Cast with a tech slot of 8th level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 7
